text:
marta: Hey team — new hire Priya (SWE) starts Mon. She's remote in Mumbai; Checkr showing pending and we need an I-9 verification workaround (no on-site). Can we schedule vendor kiosk verification? Links/slots below.
jamal: Do we have a preferred kiosk vendor in Mumbai? What's her timezone and preferred start date?
devon: We usually use IDNow (vendor). Link: https://idnow.example/ (internal). We can allocate a voucher. I'll book AM slot IST. Need full legal name + ID type (passport/driver's).
marta: Sent Priya the secure intake form for name + dob + ID type + phone. Pinged @hr-bot to generate voucher.
hr-bot: Voucher created VCHR-8392 — expires in 7 days. Calendar invite sent to Priya (priya@example.com) and marta.
alex: Background check shows 'missing SSN confirmation' in Checkr. Did Priya submit SSN via the secure form?
marta: Yes she submitted SSN last night via the secure portal. Link to intake: https://hr-secure.example/forms/priya
devon: Rechecked Checkr — status now 'clear' pending final HR sign-off. I'll upload the report to the private onboarding folder and mark completed.
lina: Day-1 plan for Priya (IST): 09:00 — welcome + manager intro (Zoom: https://zoom.example/meet/priya); 10:30 — IT & laptop provisioning; 13:00 — New Hire orientation (HR). Vendor can take photo and issue a temporary QR e-badge valid 30 days.
jamal: Laptop shipping — need to confirm address. Priya asked for express delivery tomorrow if possible. Marta ok to ship express?
marta: OK to ship express to the home address on file. Please include an LTE hotspot and power adapter in the package.
devon: Noted. I'll update the ticket to IT and confirm tracking when created.
hr-bot: Checklist update: I-9 verified via voucher VCHR-8392; BG check clear; onboarding calendar invites sent. Anything else before Monday?
